question: Who is credited with reviving the Manipuri dance tradition in the early 20th century?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** played a pivotal role in reviving the **Manipuri dance tradition** in the early 20th century.
 
• Tagore discovered the beauty and spiritual depth of Manipuri dance during his travels and incorporated it into the curriculum at **Visva-Bharati University**, Shantiniketan.
 
• He recognized the dance form’s unique blend of **grace, devotion, and storytelling**, which was deeply rooted in the **Vaishnavite traditions** of Manipur.
 
• Manipuri dance is characterized by its **soft, lyrical movements**, emphasizing the spiritual aspect of dance rather than technical virtuosity.
 
• Tagore’s efforts helped introduce Manipuri dance to the broader Indian cultural landscape and ensured its preservation and promotion.
 
• His work contributed significantly to enhancing the status of Manipuri dance as one of the **classical dance forms of India**.
